# authwise_guard_tenant (Data Source)

A Guard tenant, under a parent Authwise tenant. Nothing else in Guard exists until this does. awtenant creates it; the provider only reads it. `users` is where the tenant's people sign in and are decided. This data source reads one by its full resource name, or by its slug.

A slug is an alias of the tenant's id, never a reference: look the tenant up by slug and pass `guard_tenant_id` to other resources. A renamed tenant's old slug resolves to nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a Guard tenant up by its slug, so a configuration never hard-codes a
# gt-… id. The slug is only an alias: pass guard_tenant_id on.
data "authwise_guard_tenant" "millcreek" {
  slug = "millcreek"
}

resource "authwise_guard_enrolment_grant" "engineering" {
  tenant_id    = data.authwise_guard_tenant.millcreek.guard_tenant_id
  subject_type = "group"
  subject_id   = "g-01"
}

# Or read it by its full resource name.
data "authwise_guard_tenant" "by_name" {
  name = "tenants/gt-01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the Guard tenant to read (`tenants/gt-…`). Exactly one of `name` and `slug`.
- `slug` (String) The Guard tenant's slug, a DNS label (`millcreek`), resolved to the tenant through guard-control's `ResolveTenant`. Exactly one of `name` and `slug`. Empty on a tenant read by name that has none. A lookup by slug needs guard-control with the directory (guard-control#57).

### Read-Only

- `config` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `guard_tenant_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `parent_tenant_id` (String)
- `product_client_id` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `users` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `access_endpoint` (String)
- `administers` (Boolean)
- `audience` (String)
- `console_client_id` (String)
- `issuer` (String)
- `step_up_condition_id` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
